capabilities: Render standardform code blocks as styled argument reconstructions
Parse premise and conclusion identifiers ending in a colon or period
Draw conclusion separator lines with -- and text
Mark inductive inference with a double line using ==
Escape colons and periods inside premise or conclusion text with a backslash
disambiguation: Not a general code-block syntax highlighter; it only renders code blocks written in the plugin's Standard Form logical syntax.
extras: The README references a demo but its images were removed; formatting rules (identifier punctuation and escaping) are the main documentation.
problem: Obsidian displays logic notation written in code blocks as plain monospaced text, making standard-form arguments hard to read.
summary: Renders code blocks tagged with the standardform language as styled logical argument reconstructions, with premises, conclusion lines, and inference markers.
